entities.name: Inga Rune-Eyes
entities.description: Blind seer and leader of the Omenseekers clan of Bretagard on Kaldheim, able to chart routes through the Cosmos.

entities.name: Omenseekers
entities.description: A clan of humans from Bretagard on Kaldheim, led by Inga.

entities.name: Bretagard
entities.description: A realm of Kaldheim where the human clans live.

entities.name: Kaldheim
entities.description: The plane on which Inga lives.

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: A planeswalker who joined with Inga to hunt Vorinclex.

entities.name: Vorinclex
entities.description: One of New Phyrexia's praetors who invaded Kaldheim.

entities.name: Alrund
entities.description: God of the Cosmos who traveled with the party under the name Asi and created a barrier against Vorinclex.

entities.name: Aldergard
entities.description: Forest where the party engaged Vorinclex.

entities.name: King Harald
entities.description: King with whom the clan leaders agreed that elves and humans must live in peace.

entities.name: Doomskar
entities.description: An invasion that swept open Omenpaths into Bretagard.

entities.name: Esika
entities.description: A god whose connection to the Cosmos was disrupted by the Phyrexian Invasion Tree and who sought Inga's help.

entities.name: Phyrexian Invasion Tree
entities.description: A corrupted entity grown from the stolen essence of the World Tree that pierced the Cosmos on Kaldheim.

entities.name: World Tree
entities.description: Sacred tree from which Vorinclex stole a fragment of essence.

events.summary: Inga joins the planeswalker Kaya to hunt a dangerous monster, which proves to be Vorinclex.
events.quote: Inga joined up with the planeswalker Kaya to hunt an extremely dangerous monster that already had caused destruction on the plane.

events.summary: At Aldergard forest the party fights Vorinclex; Asi reveals himself as Alrund, who raises a barrier, and Vorinclex leaves Bretagard.
events.quote: Alrund used his magic to create a mystical barrier between Vorinclex and Inga's people and the praetor left Bretagard

events.summary: Inga and the other clan leaders lead the Bretagard armies against the invaders of Tibalt's Doomskar.
events.quote: lead the Bretagard armies against the invading army that swept open Omenpaths during Tibalt 's Doomskar

events.summary: Vorinclex steals a fragment of the World Tree's essence, which becomes the Phyrexian Invasion Tree and disrupts Esika's navigation of the Cosmos.
events.quote: Esika lost her ability to navigate the vast, interplanar pathways that make up the Cosmos

events.summary: Esika seeks Inga's aid, and Inga's vision lets Esika's chariot cross the disrupted Cosmos.
events.quote: With Inga’s guidance, Esika’s chariot is now able to traverse the disrupted Cosmos

relations.quote: Inga Rune-Eyes is the leader of the Omenseekers clan of humans
Inga joined up with the planeswalker Kaya to hunt an extremely dangerous monster

relations.note: guides the goddess through the Cosmos
relations.quote: Esika sought aid from a mortal she trusted implicitly: Inga Rune-Eyes, the leader of the Omenseeker clan.

relations.note: assaulted her and stole essence of the World Tree
relations.quote: the god Esika narrowly escaped a devastating assault by Vorinclex
